1.overview: Battling to cover up their own secrets, Cora and Olwen partner to hunt a rogue colleague.

1.overview: Cora and Olwen track runaways to a Mexico City hideout. As dark ambitions clash with hidden secrets, both women confront painful pasts.

1.overview: Out of time and out of options, Olwen turns to Cora. Their uneasy alliance is tested when the past catches up to their doorstep.

overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

seasons.name: Miniseries
seasons.overview: Cora, a fugitive turned Blade Runner, partners with Olwen, a dying Replicant, to hunt a runaway in a reborn Los Angeles. Together they uncover a truth threatening to destroy their fragile city.

tagline: Welcome to a future we no longer control.
title: Blade Runner 2099
